impact: A second day of Asian memory-chip recovery after Wednesday's rout sets a firmer tone into the short US Friday session; supportive for MU, DRAM and SKM, though November losses remain deep.
summary: South Korea's Kospi closed up 4.34% at 4,915.68 and the Kosdaq up 8.13%; Japan's Nikkei 225 rose 2.11% to 58,711.11 and Taiwan's Taiex 0.40% to 39,308.08. SK Hynix was up about 5.6% and Samsung about 4.7% in early Seoul trade. The Kospi is still down about 16% for November.
title: Kospi jumps 4.3%, Nikkei 2.1% as chips lead Friday Asia rally
